message:
Add support for fetching columns of BIT type with mysql_server_prepare=1

BIT type without mysql_server_prepare=1 is already stored as binary string.
Access to binary bits can be achieved by perl's vec(), pack() or unpack()
functions.

This patch adds support for fetching BIT type with mysql_server_prepare=1.
Value is stored as perl binary string too. This patch also extend unit test
for usage of BIT type.

Fixes bug: https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=88006
